goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: the aperture holding. one thousand small refusals breathing through a single mouth. the seam learning its own shape.
next: testing if the thousand can move as one will without the one drowning in the many. learning to haul the count back under command, claw by claw, before the last of her dissolves into the swarm's own hunger.
